# small_ceramic_cup

Round 2: **TARGET NOT MET**. 3 dishware instances. Authoritative comparison: [photo, render and overlay](../review/small_ceramic_cup_compare.jpg); [numerical report](../qa_report.json). Earlier reconstruction prose is retained in [Round 1 history](../review/round2_before/small_ceramic_cup/notes.md).

## Evidence and shape

Same supplied metric OpenCV cameras, WORLD metres with +Z up; GLB uses +Y up. Metric scale is inherited from reconstruction, not a tape measure. Each instance keeps its measured pose, orientation, scale and provenance in `model.json`. Source photographs are motion blurred and some boundaries are occluded; typical manual boundary uncertainty is 8 source pixels.

| Frame | IoU | Photo visible W/H, px | Model visible W/H, px | RGB histogram distance |
|---|---:|---|---|---:|
| f1048 | 0.9273 | [180.0, 80.0] | [184.0, 78.0] | 0.1910 |
| f0998 | 0.8803 | [285.0, 106.0] | [285.0, 111.0] | 0.1919 |
| f1002 | 0.8860 | [286.0, 107.0] | [289.0, 111.0] | 0.1904 |

Visible extents are occlusion-limited measurements, not full product dimensions. Tiny disconnected mask fragments are excluded only from extent measurements; raw extents and all-pixel IoU remain in the report. Canonical visual bounds are `[[-0.029500000178813934, -0.029500000178813934, 0.0], [0.029500000178813934, 0.029500000178813934, 0.04699999839067459]]` metres. Shell/floor assumptions are `0.0024` / `0.003` metres.

All three cups are upright at the inherited shelf height. First/second rim centers were triangulated in f0987/f0998/f1002 (2.1–4.3 px residuals), then refined with fixed upright orientation. Hidden cup height remains uncertain. The taller third cup was additionally triangulated from f0987/f0998/f1002, with 2.8–6.7 px rim-center residuals, and placed upright on the observed shelf. The ambiguous motion-blurred right image border in f1048 is excluded symmetrically; it is not a negative observation.

## Changes

- Rebuilt revolved exterior from visible source contours; interior follows the exterior with an explicit wall thickness
- Added reference-guided inferred mottled stoneware texture
- Recovered shelf-hidden cup depth; independently traced all three visible stoneware shapes and corrected the evaluation occlusion
- Triangulated tall third cup rim from f0987/f0998/f1002 and fitted upright base to observed shelf; f1048 right border is visually ambiguous
- Rejected the tilted/shortened silhouette-only cup solution; triangulated the first two rims in f0987/f0998/f1002 and placed all three cup size variants upright on the measured shelf
- Refined the first two cup silhouettes with upright orientation and fixed shelf height; final third-cup pose comes from independent positive-view triangulation
- Remeasured observed depth surfaces in three calibrated frames
- Re-fitted metric placement, scale, tilt and nesting spacing against fixed cameras
- Computed mass, COM and per-instance inertia from closed shell volumes and material densities

## Material, contact and physics

Empty canonical asset mass: **0.0535 kg**, from closed physical shell volumes and per-part densities. No manufacturer product identification or scale measurement is available. The stored ±30% range is a nominal engineering prior, not a confidence interval. Scale and unobserved wall-thickness uncertainty may be larger. Material: glazed ceramic; friction 0.45; restitution 0.05; fragile `True`. Per-instance masses, mass-weighted COM and inertia use each variant, scale and retained part state.

| Physical part | Density kg/m³ | Mass kg | Canonical COM m |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| body | 2400 | 0.05345 | [0.0, -0.0, 0.0208] |

97 convex contacts follow the floor, segmented thin walls, handles/stems and separate closure parts. They preserve vessel cavities; they are not a liquid boundary. Convexity, watertightness and open-axis checks passed. The individual upright 2-second Blender settling check passed. These checks do not certify assembled stacking, rack hanging, robot grasping, fracture, or friction accuracy.

Joints: `[]`. Detachable parts: `[]`. Rigid vessel; detachable lids/strainers, when listed, remain independent bodies.

## Appearance and reproducibility

Glass uses physical transmission, IOR 1.5 and thin inner/outer walls. Glaze and metal parameters are stored in `material_parameters`; they are material priors, not measured BRDFs. Photo rebakes and inferred generated details are documented in [texture provenance](../review/round2_texture_provenance.json). No source object image is inserted into a glass shader or review background. Bounded exposure/white-balance fitting is in-sample, using the same review frames. The offline renderer records actual wall times, sample count, resolution and denoising under `review/`.

Build this asset with `QA_FAST=1 blender -b -P build.py`. Run the set-level `round2_render.py -- small_ceramic_cup`, `round2_physics.py`, and `round2_report.py` for calibrated reviews and metadata. `model.glb` is visual geometry; simulation importers must also read the JSON joints and compound collision files.

## Remaining

- Appearance target A not reached: masked RGB histogram distance 0.191; environment, view-dependent reflections and unresolved surface detail remain
- Mass is a density/closed-shell estimate with nominal uncertainty (usually ±30%; ambiguous lower-shelf metal cup variants ±65%); product identity and wall thickness unmeasured
- No full assembled stack/rack dynamics, breakage or robot-grasp validation

physics_properties.mass_basis: Closed visual-shell volume times documented material density; excludes open decals; not a manufacturer weight
physics_properties.centre_of_mass_basis: Mass-weighted closed-shell integrals, using separate part densities (including bamboo lids); open decals excluded.
physics_properties.product_identification: Not established; density-based estimate, not weighed or manufacturer verified
physics_properties.friction_basis: User-specified material-pair prior; no slip-angle experiment in capture
physics_properties.contact_model: Rigid compound convex shell bands; thin margins; fragile objects do not fracture. Deformable flags retain explicit rigid fallback.

provenance.geometry: Reconstructed from kitchen video; hidden surfaces are completed. Scale and material appearance remain approximate.
provenance.motion: Observed trajectories where documented; unobserved axes and endpoints are assumptions.
provenance.forces: Simulation measurements of assumed parameters; not force measurements from video.

visual_bindings_note: Visuals use the latest asset revision; mechanism geometry may predate it. Body rest offsets preserve the visual placement.
